translation_notes.46-cn: Render 全日本第一位決定戦 in Simplified Chinese as 全日本第一位决定战, preserving All-Japan first-place identity.
translation_notes.46-tw: Render the Japanese 第一位決定戦 as 第一位決定戰 in Traditional Chinese, preserving 全日本.
translation_notes.46-ko: Translate 全日本第一位決定戦 as 전일본 제1위 결정전. This retains the national scope and first-place decision competition, distinct from Kansai Ki-in and the earlier Nihon Ki-in title.
translation_notes.69-ko: Render 梦百合杯世界围棋公开赛 as 몽백합배 세계바둑오픈전, preserving sponsor, world, Go and open tournament scope.
translation_notes.61-ko: Render 应氏杯世界职业围棋锦标赛 as 응씨배 세계프로바둑선수권대회, preserving Ing sponsor identity and the world professional Go championship.
translation_notes.73-tw: Convert 全国围棋团体赛 into Traditional Chinese 全國圍棋團體賽 with explicit 中國 country scope.
translation_notes.73-jp: Render 全国围棋团体赛 as 全国囲碁団体戦 with 中国 country scope; preserve the domestic team competition rather than individual or international play.
translation_notes.73-ko: Render 中国全国围棋团体赛 as 중국 전국바둑단체전, preserving national domestic team competition scope.
translation_notes.73-en: Translate the Chinese national team Go competition as Chinese National Team Go Championship. Team describes the domestic competition format, not matches of China's national representative team.
translation_notes.81-cn: Convert 『聯電盃』職業圍棋賽 into Simplified Chinese 联电杯职业围棋赛, omit the sponsor's typographic quotation brackets, and add 台湾 to preserve this domestic competition identity.
translation_notes.81-tw: Normalize the officially captured 『聯電盃』職業圍棋賽 to the display title 聯電盃職業圍棋賽 by removing only typographic quotation brackets. This is a declared title rendering, without a claim that the unquoted target was found verbatim in the captured body.
translation_notes.81-jp: Render the Taiwanese 『聯電盃』職業圍棋賽 as 台湾聯電杯プロ囲碁戦, retaining the sponsor and professional Go competition scope.
translation_notes.81-ko: Render the Taiwanese professional Go tournament as 대만 UMC배 프로바둑대회. UMC is explicitly identified in the same native Haifong source as the sponsoring 聯華電子 company.
